title: Man Taking Selfie in Mirror
description: A man with dark hair and a beard holds a black smartphone in his right hand while taking a selfie in a mirror. He stares directly at the viewer with a neutral expression from a dark setting with a small patch of light around his face and upper body.
prompt: A man with short dark hair and a full beard holds a black smartphone in his right hand taking a selfie while looking straight at the viewer in a mirror. He wears a black t-shirt and appears from the chest up against a very dark almost black background with only a small area of light illuminating his face and shoulders. The overall scene is very dark and moody with high contrast between the illuminated subject and the surrounding blackness.
